_about: Art roster for the Hellhound Derby. tint: per-part colour baked into the render (houndlib.tint); build: skeleton = Hungry Harry. gait: overrides of houndlib.GALLOP (how the hound runs). short: the name the others use in trash talk. note: the art note (how it runs); bio: the line chat sees on the lineup. hue / sat: hue-rotate and saturation of the lava glow; cadence: stride-rate multiplier; fx: overlay effects hung on the anchor points the renderer records (paw_fire, embers, tail_flame, mouth_fire, mouth_smoke, drool, sulfur, flies, dust, slime, lightning, frost, soul_fire).

hounds.name: Cinder
hounds.note: the sleek racer: the default full-run gait
hounds.bio: Paws of fire. Thinks it's the fastest thing in Hell.

hounds.name: Gnash
hounds.note: all teeth: head lower, ears pinned flat, jaws snapping every stride
hounds.bio: All teeth, no brakes. Leaves a trail of slime.

hounds.name: Three-Heads Terry
hounds.note: three heads, three opinions, one body
hounds.bio: Three heads, three opinions, one body.

hounds.name: Sparks
hounds.note: wired wrong: twitchy, fast, ears up, leaves crackling prints
hounds.bio: Wired wrong. Every footstep is a lightning strike.

hounds.name: Beelzebubba
hounds.note: the lovable lump (gluttony, mostly): bouncy, head up, mouth wide open, tail wagging, shorter stride
hounds.bio: The lovable lump. Will stop mid-race for a snack.

hounds.name: Ember
hounds.note: the elegant one: longest reach, deep back flex, smooth, mouth nearly closed
hounds.bio: The elegant one, with a tail that's actually on fire.

hounds.name: Lil' Brimstone
hounds.note: small and scrappy: quick short strides, ears up, tail up
hounds.bio: Small, scrappy, smells like sulfur. Fights everyone.

hounds.name: Mange
hounds.note: the scruffy limper: one hind leg barely reaches, head nods on it, one ear up, tail tucked
hounds.bio: Fleas, a limp, and absolutely nothing to lose.

hounds.name: Hungry Harry
hounds.note: nothing left but bones, and still hungry
hounds.bio: Nothing left but bones, and still hungry.
